Nina (ML Eng): Noticed unstable top-k ordering after onboarding ranker-compact-q4 with async-kv prefetch. Short-query NDCG drops ~2.4% vs baseline but MRR slightly improves.
Omar (Eval): Can you give a tiny repro and the diffs?
Nina (ML Eng): Repro: `./run_eval --model ranker-compact-q4 --slice short --seed 42 --batcher async-kv --kvcache=false`. Two runs, same seed, different orders: runA: [900, 31, 7] runB: [31, 900, 7]. ndcg@10 0.685 -> 0.664, mrr@10 0.452 -> 0.459.
Dev (Infra): We rolled async-kv prefetch yesterday (infra/roll-222). It allows out-of-order completions to lower tail latency.
Priya (Prod): Is this visible in canary? Should we pause?
Nina (ML Eng): Repro occurs in shadowbench and on canary 2%. Attached a small log of dot products showing tiny fp diffs.
Omar (Eval): Likely amplified by q4 per-channel scales + async reorder. Quick mitigations: 1) deterministic tie-breaker by candidate id for tiny score deltas, 2) gate prefetch to in-order for canary.
Nina (ML Eng): Patch with deterministic tie-breaker: `if abs(a-b)<1e-6: a.id < b.id`. Ran it locally: ndcg recovered to 0.682, mrr back to 0.451.
Dev (Infra): I can force in-order prefetch on canary nodes for that model and monitor.
Priya (Prod): Please do. Add a smoke-check that asserts stable topk ordering for a fixed seed post-deploy.
Omar (Eval): Also run ablation: q4 vs q8 with prefetch on/off to isolate quant vs scheduling.
Nina (ML Eng): Starting ablation now, will upload results and any embedding dumps to the snapshot.
ci-bot: Snapshot saved -> s3://redwood-shadows/3509999997-compactq4-prefetch-logs.tar.gz
